# Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction

> Prakhar India is Uttar Pradesh's premier RERA-compliant real estate developer and turnkey construction engineering firm. Operating across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh, Prakhar India specializes in gated plot townships, luxury architectural villa construction, commercial plazas, and civil infrastructure.

## Core Business Identity & Entity Profile
- **Company Name:** Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction (Prakhar Enterprises)
- **Corporate Head Office:** Prakhar India Tower, Vindhyachal Highway, Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh - 231001, India
- **Regional Hubs:** Lucknow, Noida, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Kanpur, Gorakhpur, Agra, Bareilly, Jhansi, Ghaziabad
- **Direct Helpline:** +91 90444 99111
- **Official Email:** contact@prakharind.com
- **Website:** https://prakharind.com
- **RERA & Compliance:** 100% RERA Approved Township Plots & UP Govt Certified Contractors
- **Track Record:** ₹450+ Crore Projects Delivered, 1.2 Million+ Sq. Ft Built, 2,800+ Happy Families

## Key Services
- **Turnkey Villa Construction:** End-to-end architectural 3D layout design, RCC structure execution, M25 concrete, Tata/Jindal TMT steel, CP fittings, and 10-year structural warranty.
- **RERA Approved Plots:** Freehold, clear-title residential plots in gated townships with 40ft wide roads, underground drainage, solar streetlights, and 24/7 security.
- **Commercial Property Development:** High-street retail shops, office floors, and shopping multiplex plazas in prime UP growth corridors.
- **Structural Safety & Inspection Audit:** 250+ point structural engineering safety checks, soil testing, and material quality certifications.

## Turnkey Construction Rates in Uttar Pradesh (2026 Rate Card)
- **Standard Tier:** ₹1,650 / sq.ft built-up area (Fe550 TMT Steel, OPC 43 Cement, Ceramic Tiles, standard CP fittings).
- **Premium Tier:** ₹2,100 / sq.ft built-up area (Tata Tiscon TMT, UltraTech Cement, Vitrified 4x2 Tiles, Jaquar CP fittings).
- **Luxury Architectural Tier:** ₹2,650+ / sq.ft built-up area (Italian Marble flooring, Kohler CP fittings, UPVC Double Glazed windows, Smart Automation).
